6(3).title: Transfer of application
6(3).rule: If the PIO does not hold the records, the application is transferred to the public authority that does, within five days.

7(1).title: Response period
7(1).rule: Records are supplied within thirty days; where the request concerns the life or liberty of a person, within forty-eight hours.

8(1)(j).title: Personal information exemption
8(1)(j).rule: Information that is personal to a third party and unrelated to any public activity or interest is exempt unless the PIO is satisfied the larger public interest justifies disclosure.

19.title: First appeal
19.rule: A first appeal lies to the first appellate authority within thirty days of the response period expiring, or of receiving a reply.

fee.title: Application fee
fee.rule: A fee of ten rupees accompanies the application; applicants below the poverty line are exempt. State variations are seeded assumptions, not verified law.

exemptions.summary: Contempt of court or breach of parliamentary privilege
Danger to life or physical safety of any person
Impedes investigation, prosecution or apprehension of offenders
Personal information of a third party with no public interest

routing.rule: Decide central versus state first, then the department, then the PIO. Below the threshold, ask the citizen instead of guessing.
